summary: Terra Property Trust filed an 8-K/A disclosing cash flow projections in connection with its exchange offer for its 6.00% Senior Notes due 2026. Holders can exchange into new 11.00% Senior Secured Notes due 2027 plus cash. The filing indicates ~$35.8M of notes (65.7%) have non-binding indications of interest. Projected cash flows from April to September 2026 show net outflows depending on participation level. The exchange is structured as a liability management exercise to extend maturities and reduce near-term cash demands. Watch for participation rate and any potential subsequent restructuring or distressed exchange.
